text:
carla: Following up on PM-2026-051: routing + DNS retry amplification. Posting owners and short checks here. Root cause summary: control-plane reconcile loop re-applied stale LB routes during a canary flip, some hosts honored cached DNS longer than intended, and TLS retries amplified client traffic. Need owners, short ETAs, and verification steps.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: PM-2026-051 https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-051 :bookmark_tabs: 

tom: I'll own the reconcile mitigation. Plan: add an optimistic lock (version check) on route applies and a temporary halt flag for canary pools. Mitigation ETA: 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC.

jian: I'll take DNS invalidation. Plan: reduce canary flip TTL to 10s, add a push invalidation event, and instrument dns_shadow_count. ETA: 2026-06-12 18:00 UTC.

lina: TLS side: region-b saw handshake retries during rotation. I'll deploy rotation jitter, tighten cert cache, and add histogram metrics for handshake_retry by region. ETA: 2026-06-13 11:00 UTC.

ashok: I'll own monitoring + runbook updates. Adding composite alert: (lb_reconcile_errors > 5 in 5m) OR (dns_shadow_count > 10 in 10m) OR (edge_tls_handshake_retry_rate > 1% in 5m) => page networking-sre. ETA: 2026-06-12 20:00 UTC.

carla: Action list (confirm owners):
- ACTION tom: optimistic lock + canary halt flag 1: ETA 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC
- ACTION jian: TTL reduce + push invalidation + metric 1: ETA 2026-06-12 18:00 UTC
- ACTION lina: rotation jitter + cache tightening + metrics 1: ETA 2026-06-13 11:00 UTC
- ACTION ashok: composite alerts + runbook snippet 1: ETA 2026-06-12 20:00 UTC

tom: quick note: will also short-circuit reconcile if >3 rapid retries to avoid thrash.

jian: note: will emit dns_shadow_count and a small dashboard tile for the postmortem.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync 2026-06-13 09:00 UTC.

tom: Update 2026-06-12 14:45 UTC: optimistic lock merged to canary, deploying. Holding for gradual rollout.

jian: Update 2026-06-12 17:10 UTC: TTL change applied to canary, invalidation events firing; early shadow_count down ~80%.

lina: Update 2026-06-13 10:30 UTC: rotation jitter + cache changes rolled to region-b; handshake_retry down ~60% in early telemetry. Planning full rollout after verification.

ashok: Update 2026-06-13 12:00 UTC: composite alerts added and tested (simulated hits). Runbook snippet: "If lb_reconcile_errors > 5 OR dns_shadow_count > 10 OR edge_tls_handshake_retry_rate rises >1% => page networking-sre, attach probe CSV, and consider canary-halt rollback." Linked in PM-2026-051.

carla: Thanks team. I'll convert these to tickets and set a 72h recurrence check for retry-amplification patterns in the incident playbook. Reopen here if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
